title: A Human 3D Extracellular Matrix-Adipocyte Culture Model for Studying Matrix-Cell Metabolic Crosstalk
protocol: Prepare 2% bovine serum albumin (BSA) in 1x phosphate buffered saline solution (PBS).
Filter sterilize the BSA-PBS solution.
Store the filtered BSA-PBS solution at 4°C.
Prepare Type II collagenase at a concentration of 2 mg/mL using 2% BSA in 1x PBS.
Use the prepared collagenase immediately after preparation.
Prepare Red Blood Cell (RBC) Lysing Solution using 1.5 M NH4Cl, 100 mM NaHCO3, and 10 mM disodium EDTA in deionized water (DI/H2O).
Store the RBC Lysing Solution at 4°C.
Prepare 1x RBC Lysing Solution from a 10x stock solution in DI/H2O immediately before use.
Prepare Growth Media by mixing 15% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 1% antibiotic-antimycotic solution (ABAM) in Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium:Nutrient Mixture F-12 (DMEM/F12).
Filter sterilize the Growth Media and store at 4°C.
Prepare Preadipocyte Freezing Solution by mixing 10% Dimethyl Sulfoxide, 15% FBS in DMEM/F12 media.
Filter sterilize the Freezing Solution and store at 4°C.

Prepare Differentiation Media containing 10 mg/L transferrin, 33 µM biotin, 0.5 µM human insulin solution, 17 µM D-pantothenic acid hemicalcium salt, 100 nM dexamethasone, 2 nM T3 (triiodothyronine), 1 µM ciglitizone, and 540 µM IBMX in DMEM/F12 with 1% ABAM.
Filter sterilize the Differentiation Media and store at 4°C.
Prepare Freezing Buffer Solution by mixing 10 mM Tris base, 5 mM EDTA, 1% ABAM, and 1% PMSF in DI/H2O.
Stir the solution to dissolve EDTA.
Adjust pH to 8.0 with HCl or NaOH.
Store the freezing buffer at 4 °C for up to 3 months.
Prepare Enzymatic Solution #1 by mixing 1% ABAM in 0.25% trypsin-EDTA.
Store enzymatic solution #1 at 4 °C for up to 3 months.
Prepare Rinsing Buffer Solution by mixing 137 mM NaCl, 2.68 mM KCl, 7 mM Na2HPO4, 1.5 mM KH2PO4, 1% ABAM, and 1% PMSF in sterilized DI/H2O.
Stir the solution to dissolve salts.
Adjust pH to 8.0 with HCl or NaOH.
Store rinsing buffer at 4 °C for up to 3 months.
Prepare Enzymatic Solution #2 by mixing 55 mM Na2HPO4, 17 mM KH2PO4, 4.9 mM MgSO4·7H2O, 1% ABAM, and 1% PMSF in DI/H2O.
Stir the solution to dissolve salts.
Immediately prior to use, add lipase from porcine pancreas, deoxyribonuclease I from bovine pancreas, and ribonuclease A from bovine pancreas to enzymatic solution #2.
Prepare Polar Solvent Extraction Solution by mixing 1% ABAM, 1% PMSF in isopropanol.
Prepare 70% ethanol solution containing 1% ABAM and 1% PMSF in DI/H2O.
Add ABAM and PMSF just prior to use.
Prepare Storage Solution by mixing 1% ABAM, 1% PMSF in 1x PBS.
Store storage solution at 4 °C for up to 3 months.
Prepare serum starvation media by mixing DMEM/F12 and 1% ABAM.
Filter sterilize the serum starvation media and store it at 4°C.
Prepare 200 nM human insulin solution in 1x PBS immediately before use.
Dilute isoproterenol to a working concentration of 3 µM for assay from a stock solution in PBS (3 mM).
Add 5-10 g of intact VAT to 15-25 mL of Freezing Buffer Solution in a 50 mL conical tube.
Store samples at -80°C until decellularization, for up to 1 month.
Place 2 g of intact VAT in 20 mL of collagenase type II solution in a 50 mL conical tube.
Mince the tissue thoroughly using sterile scissors within the conical tube.
Incubate the minced tissue on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 37 °C for 60 min.
Filter the resultant digest through a 100 µm nylon mesh into a fresh 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the sample at 270 x g for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 2 ml of 1x RBC Lysing Solution.
Incubate the suspension for 1 min at 25 °C.
Add 10 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 to the lysed cells.
Centrifuge the sample at 270 x g for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 ml of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 100 mm Petri dish with a pipette.
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 until cells reach 80-100% confluence, typically 2-6 days.
Change media every 2-3 days.
Detach and wash the confluent cells.
Remove media with a pipette.
Apply 4 mL of 0.25% trypsin-EDTA to adherent cells.
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 min, periodically swirling the plate gently.
Add 20 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 and resuspend the detached cells with a pipette.
Transfer to a fresh 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 270 x g for 10 min.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet once in 1x PBS.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 20 mL of fresh 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 with a pipette.
Transfer the cell suspension to a T-150 culture flask.
Culture cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Split and expand cells every 2-3 days as they reach 80-100% confluence by applying 7 mL of 0.25% trypsin-EDTA per flask, expanding from one flask to 8 flasks.
Detach cells in 8 flasks with 7 mL of 0.25% trypsin-EDTA per flask as described above.
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Add 8 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 per flask and resuspend the detached cells with a pipette.
Transfer the entire cell suspension evenly into three 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 270 x g for 10 min.
Resuspend the resultant cell pellets in 5 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 in a 15 mL conical tube.
Count cells using a cell counter and Trypan blue.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 270 x g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in Preadipocyte Freezing Solution to achieve a final concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Aliquot 1 mL of cell suspension into each 1.5 mL cryovial tube.
Store cryovials at -80 °C for 1 day.
Transfer cryovials to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage (3-6 months).
Thaw one cryovial in a 37 °C water bath for 3-5 minutes when ready for use.
Resuspend the cells in 20 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12.
Centrifuge at 270 x g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 20 mL of 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 and pipette into a single T-150 flask.
Grow cells to 80% confluence over 2-3 days at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Detach cells with 7 mL of 0.25% trypsin-EDTA per flask.
Resuspend the cells at a concentration of 3 million cells/mL in 15% FBS-DMEM/F12.
Freeze-thaw previously frozen VAT samples stored in Freezing Buffer Solution three times, alternating between -80 °C and a 37 °C water bath for 20 minutes each.
Incubate thawed samples at 37 °C with gentle periodic manual agitation.
Using sterile forceps, transfer VAT samples to fresh 50 mL conical tubes containing 15-25 mL of Enzymatic Solution #1.
Incubate overnight on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 37 °C.
Wash samples three times with 15-25 mL of Rinsing Buffer Solution on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 37 °C for 20 minutes each wash.
Pour off the Rinsing Buffer Solution after each wash.
Transfer samples to fresh 50 mL conical tubes containing 15-25 mL of Enzymatic Solution #2 and incubate on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 37 °C overnight.
Wash samples three times with 15-25 mL of Rinsing Buffer Solution on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 37 °C for 20 minutes each wash.
Pour off the Rinsing Buffer Solution after each wash.
Transfer samples to fresh 50 mL conical tubes containing 15-25 mL of Polar Solvent Extraction Solution and incubate on an orbital shaker at 130 rpm and 25 °C overnight.
Transfer samples to fresh 50 mL conical tubes containing 15-25 mL of Rinsing Buffer Solution.
Wash samples 3x on an orbital shaker (130 rpm, 37 °C, 20 min each wash).
Wash samples 3x with 15-25 mL of 70% ethanol on an orbital shaker (130 rpm, 37 °C, 20 min each wash), pouring off the ethanol after each wash.
Wash samples once with Storage Solution on an orbital shaker (130 rpm, 37 °C, 20 min).
Transfer washed samples to fresh 50 mL conical tubes containing 15-25 mL of Storage Solution.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.
Transfer stored ECM fragments to individual wells of a 24-well plate using sterile forceps.
Wash with 500 µL of 70% ethanol 3x on an orbital shaker (130 rpm, 37 °C, 20 min each wash).
Rehydrate ECM by washing 3x in sterile PBS on an orbital shaker (130 rpm, 37 °C, 20 min each wash).
Cut and weigh ECM into 100 mg fragments using sterile scissors.
Place one 100 mg fragment in each well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate at 25 °C for 15 min to allow excess PBS to extrude from fragments.
Carefully remove any excess PBS with a pipette.
Seed each 100 mg ECM fragment with 20 µL of preadipocyte cell suspension (3 million cells per mL).
Pipette the cells directly into the ECM by placing the tip of pipette in the ECM and gently expelling the cell suspension into center of the matrix.
Incubate seeded ECM for 40 min at 37 °C.
For RNA extraction for qrtPCR, seed each 500 mg ECM fragments with 3 x 10^5 cells in 100 µL (3 million cells per mL).
Fill each well of the 24-well plate with 500 µL of growth media to cover the seeded ECM fragments.
Culture at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 72 h.
Aspirate 15% FBS-DMEM/F12 after 72 h, tilting the plate slightly to allow media to pool below fragment.
Add 500 µL of Differentiation Media after aspirating, changing media every 2-3 days using a similar technique for a total culture period of 14 days.
Check for differentiation using light microscopy: cells will accumulate lipids and turn brown-yellow in color.
Fix samples in 2.5% glutaraldehyde in Sorensen's phosphate buffer at 25 °C for 12 h.
Postfix samples in 1% osmium tetroxide in Sorensen's phosphate buffer at 4 °C for 1 h.
Dehydrate samples serially in ethanol.
Wash samples in hexamethyldisalizane, and air-dry.
Mount samples on a scanning electron microscopy stub with colloidal graphite.
Dry samples and sputter-coat with gold.
Capture images with a scanning electron microscope.
Aspirate media from wells with a pipette for live tissue Oil Red-O staining.
Wash samples once with 500 µL of 1x PBS per well.
Fix samples with 200 µL of 4% formalin in sterile deionized H2O at 25 °C for 15 min.
Aspirate formalin with a pipette and wash samples two times with 1x PBS (500 µL each).
Add 200 µL of 60% isopropanol to the samples at 25 °C for 5 min.
Aspirate 60% isopropanol with a pipette.
Stain samples with Oil Red-O working solution at 25 °C for 5 min.
Aspirate Oil Red-O with a pipette and then wash samples three times with 1x PBS (500 µL each).
Image the stained samples with an optical microscope.
Flash-freeze ECM-adipocyte samples in optimal cutting temperature compound.
Section the flash-frozen samples at 5 µm on a cryostat.
Place the slide in 85% propylene glycol in DI/H2O for 2 min.
Place the slide in ORO stain at 60 °C for 6 min.
Place the slide in 85% propylene glycol in DI/H2O for 1 min.
Rinse the slide twice with DI/H2O.
Place the slide in Modified Mayer's Hematoxylin from Oil Red-O staining kit for 1 min.
Rinse the slide twice with tap water.
Rinse the slide twice with DI/H2O.
Mount the coverslip using aqueous mounting medium.
Image the mounted coverslip on a microscope.
Use 500 mg ECM fragments seeded with 3 x 10^5 preadipocytes in 100 µL for RNA extraction.
Differentiate ECM-adipocyte samples as above in 6-well plates containing 3 mL of differentiation media per well.
Transfer each differentiated ECM-adipocyte sample into a 50 mL conical tube on ice using sterile forceps.
Wash empty wells with 500 µL of Buffer RLT.
Add Buffer RLT to the 50 mL conical tube with matching ECM-adipocyte sample.
Finely mince each ECM-adipocyte sample within the 50 mL conical tube while holding it on ice.
Completely freeze and thaw the conical tubes from -80 °C to 37 °C three times.
Centrifuge the conical tubes at 500 x g and 4 °C for 10 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette.
Use the supernatant for RNA extraction with a Fibrous Tissue RNA extraction Kit.
Differentiate 6 x 10^4 preadipocytes in 100 mg ECM fragments in 0.5 mL of differentiation medium in 24-well plates.
Culture for 14 days.
Remove the medium and wash ECM-adipocytes once with 1x PBS.
Add 0.5 mL/well Serum Starvation Medium and culture at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 12 h.
Remove medium and wash cells twice with 1x PBS.
Add 0.5 mL/well 2% BSA in PBS and culture at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 2 h.
Wash cells once with 1x PBS.
Add 0.5 mL/well 1x PBS with or without 200 nM insulin, and incubate at 37 °C for 40 min.
Aspirate 1x PBS.
Add 0.5 mL/well 1X PBS with 0.1 mM 2-deoxy-D-glucose, 2 µCi/mL deoxy-D-glucose, 2-[1,2-3H(N)], and incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 40 min.
Remove medium with a pipette.
Wash cells 3x with 1x PBS.
Add 420 µL of 1% SDS solution in DI/H2O, and lyse cells with vigorous pipetting.
Incubate at 25 °C for 10 min.
Collect 5 µL from each well for Bradford protein assay.
Transfer 400 µL of remaining cell lysate into 2 mL of scintillation fluid in a scintillation vial.
Count 3H-2DG activity on scintillation counter.
Remove medium after 14 days of differentiation.
Wash cells twice with warm 1x PBS.
Add 0.5 mL of serum starvation medium without insulin and optionally with 3 µM isoproterenol.
Culture adipocytes at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 72 h.
Collect culture supernatants and store at -80°C until ready for assay.
Pipette 2 µL of each supernatant into a 96-well microplate.
Reserve wells for blanks (distilled H2O) and glycerol standard solution.
Add 270 µL of free glycerol reagent to each well.
Incubate plate at 37 °C for 5 min.
Measure absorbance at 540 nm on a microplate spectrophotometer.
Calculate the concentration of glycerol and normalize with DNA from ECM.
